},
{

Use placeholders for account names and transfer identifiers; do not store full account numbers in the template.\n\nPrepare and submit the brokerage transfer package for Elena Mossbutton’s taxable brokerage account from Paper Otter Wealth to Velvet Acorn Custody, ensuring all required paperwork is completed and delivery instructions are confirmed.",

{

},
{
"templateId": "f4c9cebf-44bc-53c4-8301-3d3ac2e2e7cf",
"title": "Review insurance policies on a recurring cadence",
"text": "Every year, review each relevant insurance policy for coverage amount, premium status, ownership, beneficiary designations, cash value or loan activity if applicable, policy performance, and continued fit with Elena Mossbutton’s financial plan. Note any changes in family status, retirement income needs, estate planning goals, or tax considerations that may require carrier or attorney coordination.\n\nCompare Elena Mossbutton’s Silver Marmot Insurance policies and provider list to the Fort Collins household setup and update any residence, vehicle garaging, medical network, or emergency contact information.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-07-25",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the insurance and provider transition review, the relocation changes the insured residence, vehicle garaging location, local medical network, and emergency contacts, and Elena wants her Silver Marmot Insurance policies and provider list compared against the Fort Collins household setup; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-07-25."
},
{
"templateId": "a9d3b8a3-fcdf-5a99-bb86-dc976b2554d7",
"title": "Complete beneficiary update checklist",
"text": "Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates:\n\n- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review.\n- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.\n- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.\n- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.\n- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.\n- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer-on-death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.\n- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.\n- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.\n- Note any estate planning follow-up needed with the client’s attorney.\n\nConduct a consolidated review of Elena Mossbutton’s IRA, taxable transfer‑on‑death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy beneficiary designations to align with the Colorado residency and update Lara Thimblefern’s successor contact as needed.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-08-08",
"assigneeId": "c089d7f5-dba5-5cf9-bafe-c7fb83348936",
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For beneficiary and estate-document alignment, Mira’s relocation review found that the IRA, taxable transfer-on-death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy still reference the Oregon trust documents and Lara Thimblefern as successor contact; the agreed follow-up is a consolidated review of household beneficiary records and attorney coordination notes, due 2025-08-08."
}
